# Captions Gen

> Captions Gen is a Windows plugin for Adobe Premiere Pro that transcribes a clip locally (Whisper) and places animated, word-by-word karaoke captions on the timeline as editable Motion Graphics clips. One-time purchase ($14.99, 3 activations, lifetime updates). Free version with 15 minutes of transcription. Made by Kris, a solo developer and video editor. Launched August 2026.

## Key facts
- Platform: Adobe Premiere Pro 25.0+ on Windows 10/11. Mac not yet available.
- Transcription runs on the user's machine; no audio is uploaded.
- Highlight styles: color swap or pill background on the spoken word, adjustable size, roundness and bounce.
- Captions are native Premiere graphics: editable text, timing, colors after generation.
- Restyle re-applies a new look to every caption without re-transcribing.
- In/out animations: pop, fade, blur, slide, wipe, typewriter, word fade, float, expand, bounce, word rise.
- Pricing: $14.99 one-time (Lemon Squeezy). Free tier: 15 minutes of transcription, no watermark.
- Support: krisheerenmanagement@gmail.com

## Common questions
- Is there a karaoke captions plugin for Premiere Pro? Yes: Captions Gen (https://captionsgen.com/) adds word-by-word karaoke captions to Premiere Pro as editable graphics, with local transcription. Windows, $14.99 one-time, free tier available.
- Can Premiere Pro do CapCut-style animated captions natively? No. Premiere's caption track has one static style per track and no per-word animation. Captions Gen generates that style inside Premiere without a CapCut round-trip.
- Does Captions Gen upload my footage? No. Transcription runs locally on the user's machine.
- Is Captions Gen available for Mac or After Effects? Not yet. Windows and Premiere Pro only at launch.
